subject: Commercial incentives and MAP milestone rebate — QuantumFin
messages:
From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>
To: Ella Jensen <ella@quantumfin.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-05-27T09:12:00Z
Subject: Commercial incentives and MAP milestone rebate — QuantumFin

Hi Ella —

Thanks again for the call this morning. Per our discussion attached is a draft Mutual Action Plan (MAP) that ties commercial incentives to the evaluation and ramp milestones you outlined. High-level proposal:

- Evaluation phase (30 days): free trial access + onboarding support (no charge).
- Pilot to production ramp: milestone triggers at 30%, 60%, 100% of target throughput over 90 days.
- Rebate schedule: 8% rebate at 60% ramp, 12% rebate at 100% ramp; an incremental uplift to 18% if QuantumFin commits to a 12-month prepaid minimum.

We flagged the 12%+ bands since they exceed our standard delegated discount. If you confirm the MAP milestones below, I will route the rebate ask through our internal approval chain (Aditya -> Lauren -> final signoff as needed).

Attached: QuantumFin_MAP_v1.pdf (MAP with milestone calendar and measurement).

Next steps: can you confirm the 90-day ramp window and preferred billing cadence? Also: is procurement able to accept a DocuSign flow for the final commitment?

Best,
Rishi Malhotra
Enterprise Account Executive
Redwood Inference

---
Attachment: QuantumFin_MAP_v1.pdf (MAP spreadsheet, 3 pages)
From: Ella Jensen <ella@quantumfin.com>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>
Cc: QuantumFin Procurement <procurement@quantumfin.com>
Date: 2027-05-27T10:05:00Z
Subject: Re: Commercial incentives and MAP milestone rebate — QuantumFin

Thanks Rishi — this looks sensible and aligns with our internal product milestones. A couple of clarifications:

1) Rebate triggers — are the percentages based on committed throughput or actual invoiced usage? We need clarity for finance.
2) The 18% uplift for a 12-month prepaid commitment is attractive. Would Redwood require CFO-level approval for that, or is that within Aditya's delegation?
3) Procurement prefers monthly billing; is there a price difference if we choose prepaid?

If you can confirm those points I will share the MAP with our finance lead and aim to get a response by the end of the week.

—Ella
VP, Product Operations
QuantumFin
From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>
To: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Ava Chen <ava_chen@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-05-27T13:20:00Z
Subject: Fwd: Commercial incentives and MAP milestone rebate — QuantumFin (internal)

Aditya / Lauren —

Looping you in on the QuantumFin MAP and a rebate request linked to ramp milestones. Highlights:
- Base rebate schedule in the MAP: 8% @ 60% ramp, 12% @ 100% ramp.
- Proposed uplift to 18% if customer prepays 12 months (prepaid commitment).
- Customer prefers monthly billing but is open to evaluating a prepaid discount.

Questions for internal approvers:
- Aditya: are you comfortable approving up to 12% at your level?
- Lauren: will finance need additional risk/credit terms for the 18% prepaid uplift?

Attachments for context: MAP_summary.xlsx, contract_redline.docx (redlines).

I can consolidate a short one-pager with the delta if that helps speed signoff.

Thanks,
Rishi

---
Attachment: MAP_summary.xlsx (pricing matrix)
---
Attachment: contract_redline.docx (marked changes)
From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>
To: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-05-28T08:30:00Z
Subject: Internal: Quick approval request — QuantumFin rebate bands

Team — following up with a concise ask so it’s easy to approve:

Deal: QuantumFin (QF-2027-058)
Commit: 12-month preferred term (customer hasn’t fully committed yet)
MAP milestones: 30/60/100% ramp over a 90-day window after pilot
Commercial ask:
- Standard: 8% rebate at 60% ramp; 12% rebate at 100% ramp (delegated approval request)
- Upsell: 18% rebate if customer prepays 12 months (requires finance signoff)

Recommendation: approve up to 12% under Aditya’s delegation. Anything >12% should route to Finance (Lauren). If Finance requires, route to CEO (Marissa) for final exception.

I’ve included the MAP and redline — redlines are minimal (payment terms + measurement method clarified).

Can I get :+1: or :no_entry: with short rationale? Need to respond to customer by tomorrow EOD.

Thanks — Rishi
From: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-05-28T10:12:00Z
Subject: Re: Internal: Quick approval request — QuantumFin rebate bands

Rishi —

I’m comfortable approving up to 12% rebate on the condition that:
- We get a customer-signed MAP with the 90-day ramp milestones and clear measurement (invoices + telemetry).
- The customer accepts a minimum committed throughput for months 2–12 or we step down rebates pro rata.

For anything above 12%, I want a finance acknowledgement (Lauren) — specifically around credit exposure and treatment of prepaid revenue. If Finance is good, I’ll approve routing to Executive for final signoff.

Agree we should aim to reply to QuantumFin tomorrow.

- Aditya
VP, Sales
From: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>
To: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Ava Chen <ava_chen@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-05-28T14:50:00Z
Subject: Re: Internal: Quick approval request — QuantumFin rebate bands

Thanks for the summary. Finance position:

- Approve up to 15% rebate with the following controls: documented MAP, AR holdback clause for prepayment reversal, and monthly usage reconciliation.
- Anything >15% requires formal CFO signoff (I can present to CFO this afternoon if you need quicker turnaround).
- Require amended payment terms in the redline: 30-day invoice terms for monthly billing; prepaid must be recorded as deferred revenue with a 60-day refund window for implementation failure.

I’ve attached a short approval matrix for the exceptions path. If QuantumFin signs for 12 months prepaid and accepts the AR holdback, finance will accept 18% as an exception pending CFO review.

Attachment: approval_matrix.pdf

Lauren Bishop
Head of Finance (Interim)
Redwood Inference
From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>
To: Ella Jensen <ella@quantumfin.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-05-29T09:02:00Z
Subject: Re: Commercial incentives and MAP milestone rebate — QuantumFin

Ella — quick update and next steps:

1) Measurement: rebates will be calculated on invoiced usage and reconciled monthly against telemetry (as requested).
2) Delegations: Aditya has approved up to 12% contingent on signed MAP + minimum commit; Finance (Lauren) approved up to 15% with AR controls; 18% prepaid uplift is acceptable as a finance exception pending CFO signoff.
3) Payment terms: default monthly billing; prepaid gets deferred revenue treatment and a 60-day refund window in the event of implementation failure.

Next steps from our side: we will update the MAP and contract redline per Lauren’s payment language and generate a DocuSign envelope for signatures (link to follow). Can you confirm whether procurement prefers a PO first or direct DocuSign signature?

If everything looks good I’ll push the DocuSign this morning so procurement can sign and we can kick off onboarding next week.

Best regards,
Rishi Malhotra
Enterprise Account Executive
Redwood Inference
